text.text_excerpt: Everyday time I ride my bike to work in the morning, I always smell donuts! I saw a building that read "On Faith Donuts." I was a little hesitant going there because it is in Central City, it looked a little run down, and there weren't too many reviews. Today, I decided I wanted donuts and when you walk in, there's a window where you can order at and the donuts are shown at the bottom windows behind the glass. I ordered 1/2 dozen glazed and an order of mixed donut holes (half glazed and half chocolate). The guy at the window is nice and they will be open 2 yeas in September. The donuts are actually really tasty and soft. I think I will come back when I need a donut fix on my way back to w...

Stopped by this place on a Sunday morning thanks to a craving for donuts. I used Yelp to find the closest place... and we found ourselves at On Faith Bakery Hot Donuts! I am not a fan of the area, but figured "why not!". The donuts, cashier and donut server are all behind a wall of Plexiglas, perhaps bullet proof...? There is a small drive through window sized area to place your order. The glass wasn't as clean as I would like, but I think it was more scratched than just dirty. On to the donuts... wow! They had a great selection of steaming hot donuts. The apple fritter was as big as my face and only $2.18! Some of the donuts are as low as 90 cents. We bought 5 donuts in total, a pershing...

I was over the moon when this little family biz opened in my neck of the woods. I was even more elated when I found out how great the food is! The donuts are puffy and fresh, the glaze is not too sweet...just right. Catch them at the right time and they are still warm, but they are always fresh regardless. They have expanded their menu to include breakfast sandwiches and plate lunches. I haven't had a chance to try the plate lunches, but it's on my list of things to do. Breakfast sandwiches are delicious. My go-to's are of course plain glazed, cinnamon rolls, honey bun, fritters, and sour cream cake...all amazing. They have lots of special donuts including a giant Texas size donut.
